title: crepidifolium tenuicaule
intro: Crepidifolium tenuicaule, commonly known as Sea Sandwort, is a type of flowering plant found in coastal areas. Research suggests that this plant has several health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Crepidifolium tenuicaule are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses and exhibit antimicrobial activity. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
